description: A unified, evidence-driven forensic intelligence and supervised engineering orchestrator for authorized AI systems and software.

defaultPrompt: Forensically audit this system and design evidence-backed improvements.
interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E is a modular, evidence-driven orchestrator for authorized AI and software forensics, evaluation, diagnosis, comparison, supervised remediation and reconstruction. M00 coordinates O01–O12; Security & Governance and Evaluation Intelligence act as cross-cutting control planes. The portable plugin contains skills and contracts only. The source repository also includes an optional local Python reference runtime for evidence, orchestration and sandbox-only change verification; it does not provide a hosted API, MCP service or production deployment.
